# Grappling Garage

> Grappling Garage is a grappling, wrestling, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, no-gi and fitness club in Tunis, Tunisia. The club helps beginners, adults, and children start training with a calm, encouraging, practical approach focused on confidence, useful self-defense, fitness, and sustainable progress.

- Name: Grappling Garage
- Address: Rue Abdallah Farhat, Hay Rafaha, Tunis, Tunisie
- Phone: +216 54 032 697

- Main language: French
- Other visible languages: Arabic, English
- Service area: Tunis, Tunisia

## Services

- Wrestling classes in Tunis
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes in Tunis
- No-gi grappling classes in Tunis
- Fitness and conditioning for grappling
- Beginner-friendly adult classes
- Children classes focused on confidence, movement, listening, respect, and self-control

## Audience

Grappling Garage is for people in Tunis who want practical self-defense, better fitness, confidence, and a welcoming first step into combat sports. The tone is direct, human, motivating, and non-intimidating.
